1.w: For the music director, a psalm of David. O God whom I praise, do not ignore me.

2.w: For they say cruel and deceptive things to me; they lie to me.

3.w: They surround me and say hateful things; they attack me for no reason.

4.w: They repay my love with accusations, but I continue to pray.

5.w: They repay me evil for good and hate for love.

6.w: Appoint an evil man to testify against him. May an accuser stand at his right side.

7.w: When he is judged, he will be found guilty. Then his prayer will be regarded as sinful.

8.w: May his days be few. May another take his job.

9.w: May his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

10.w: May his children roam around begging, asking for handouts as they leave their ruined home.

11.w: May the creditor seize all he owns. May strangers loot his property.

12.w: May no one show him kindness. May no one have compassion on his fatherless children.

13.w: May his descendants be cut off. May the memory of them be wiped out by the time the next generation arrives.

14.w: May his ancestors’ sins be remembered by the Lord. May his mother’s sin not be forgotten.

15.w: May the Lord be constantly aware of them and cut off the memory of his children from the earth.

16.w: For he never bothered to show kindness; he harassed the oppressed and needy and killed the disheartened.

17.w: He loved to curse others, so those curses have come upon him. He had no desire to bless anyone, so he has experienced no blessings.

18.w: He made cursing a way of life, so curses poured into his stomach like water and seeped into his bones like oil.

19.w: May a curse attach itself to him, like a garment one puts on, or a belt one wears continually.

20.w: May the Lord repay my accusers in this way, those who say evil things about me.

21.w: O Sovereign Lord, intervene on my behalf for the sake of your reputation. Because your loyal love is good, deliver me.

22.w: For I am oppressed and needy, and my heart beats violently within me.

23.w: I am fading away like a shadow at the end of the day; I am shaken off like a locust.

24.w: I am so starved my knees shake; I have turned into skin and bones.

25.w: I am disdained by them. When they see me, they shake their heads.

26.w: Help me, O Lord my God. Because you are faithful to me, deliver me.

27.w: Then they will realize this is your work and that you, Lord, have accomplished it.

28.w: They curse, but you will bless. When they attack, they will be humiliated, but your servant will rejoice.

29.w: My accusers will be covered with shame and draped in humiliation as if it were a robe.

30.w: I will thank the Lord profusely. In the middle of a crowd I will praise him,

31.w: because he stands at the right hand of the needy to deliver him from those who threaten his life.
